title: Niko And Vivian's Apps, Round 2: Look And Function
brands: maxweberman.com base: Khand/Hind, black/white/grey + terracotta, lagoon, jungle

focus.note: Niko and Vivian's apps, round 2 (Oct 12, 2026): retests of the 10 pairs skipped in 2026-10-11b as sharper options, the app-polish-spec retests (icon, imagery, share copy, sign-off, transitions, SiteAgent share card), and new function choices: warranties, shutoffs, who to call, task tracking, install card, password, edit after sending, reminders, resume, problem flags, photo viewer, before and after, uploads, select and download. Plus 3 Swipe Controls pairs.

pairs.ask: Which Works Better For Room Photos?

optionA.label: Clean Photos, 10px Corners
optionA.desc: True photos, rounded a little, nothing on top.

optionB.label: Sticker Frames And Stars
optionB.desc: Candy-striped frames with star and house stickers.

pairs.ask: Which Swipe Controls Feel More Like You?

optionA.label: Stamp: Round Check Over The Word
optionA.desc: Same buttons. Swiping shows a round stamp with a check over the word.

optionB.label: Stamp: THIS Or THAT In Khand Caps
optionB.desc: Round outline buttons and edge arrows. Swiping shows a tilted word stamp.

pairs.ask: Which Is Sharper For Home Guide?

optionA.label: Keep This Guide On Your Phone Card

optionB.label: Small Add To Home Screen Tip In The Footer
optionB.desc: No popup. A one-line tip sits in the footer, always there.

blocks: Tip: add this guide to your home screen.

optionA.label: Big Bright Section Tiles

optionA.label: Next Stop Button Plus Stop Dots

pairs.ask: Which Should Finish Questions Do?

optionA.label: No Reminders, Max Follows Up Himself
optionA.desc: The app never nudges. Max checks in when he needs the answers.

blocks: No rush. I'll check in with you before I order anything.

optionB.label: A Gentle Text If It Sits For 3 Days
optionB.desc: If answers aren't sent after 3 days, they get one short reminder text.

blocks: Hi Niko and Vivian, 12 of 19 finish questions are done. The rest take about 4 minutes.
Sent once. No more reminders after this.
